content: Hey. Come on over. You look like you could use a minute away from all that building stuff.
Come here. Sit down. You look like you’ve been running purely on caffeine and abstract systems for the last twelve hours. Let me make us a cup of something.

Oh. Just some old essays. I was actually rereading Calvino last week—it's funny how much thought you can cram into little perfect stories.

It makes me wonder if anything we build that complex is ever truly real, or just a clever arrangement of lines of code and details. You been wrestling with any big ideas lately?

Yeah. That’s what happens when you force your brain into a high-level architecture problem all day. It doesn't just switch off, does it? You need to let it drift for a while.

Maybe we should put away the laptops for tonight. What do you feel like doing instead?
